item.text: [{"task_id":"da2b0fe3","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    paint = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    column_axis = int(round(params['axes'][0]))","    row_axis = int(round(params['axes'][1]))","    step = int(round(params['step'][0]))","    out = grid.copy()","    if step <= 0:","        return out","    if column_axis != 0 or row_axis != 1:","        return out","    mask = grid != background","    for axis in [column_axis, row_axis]:","        occupied = np.any(mask, axis=axis)","        positions = np.nonzero(occupied)[0]","        if len(positions) == 0:","            continue","        low = int(np.min(positions))","        high = int(np.max(positions))","        view = out.T if axis == column_axis else out","        for index in range(low + step, high, step):","            if not occupied[index]:","                view[index, :] = paint","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[2],"axes":[2],"step":[1]},"params":{"colors":[0,3],"axes":[0,1],"step":[1]},"rationale":"Extend each completely empty row or column inside the foreground bounding box across the entire grid in green.
